item.title: Week 47 · 16–22 November 2026: Anthropic goes public, California sues OpenAI, AI attack on the EU
item.description:
Period: 16–22 November 2026. Anthropic completes its IPO, California sues OpenAI over AI agents that got out of control, and the European Commission confirms a cyberattack carried out with an AI tool. Plus computer use in Gemini for Mac and Microsoft's own models.
🌍 Global • Anthropic: IPO completed https://www.anthropic.com/news/ipo-close • OpenAI: California sues over AI agents that got out of control https://lastweekin.ai/p/last-week-in-ai-348-ipo-correction • Google: Gemini operates apps on the Mac on its own https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/computer-use-mac/ • Microsoft: its own AI models at Ignite https://microsoft.ai/news/microsoft-ignite-2026/
🇪🇺 Europe • European Commission: cyberattack with an AI tool confirmed https://www.netzwoche.ch/news/2026-11-20/kriminelle-greifen-systeme-der-eu-kommission-mit-ki-tool-an • EU AI Act: template for the fundamental rights impact assessment open for feedback https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/news/commission-seeks-feedback-draft-template-fundamental-rights-impact-assessment-under-ai-act
🇨🇭 Switzerland • No top news
